Mahua Moitra Files Privilege Notice Over Circuit House Eviction

Trinamool Congress MP Mahua Moitra has filed a breach of privilege notice against three West Bengal officials. The notice, sent to Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, concerns an alleged late-night eviction from a circuit house in Krishnanagar. Moitra claims the officials, including Nadia District Magistrate Srikant Palli, Additional District Magistrate Nirpendra Singh, and Nazareth Deputy Collector Anamika Bera, engaged in contemptuous conduct and a breach of protocol. The incident reportedly occurred when Moitra was asked to vacate the circuit house late at night.
